text:
maria_pm: quick sync — planning Q3 hosted-api slices we need to lock down scope for: embeddings perf (latency + cost), rerank quality+throughput, and a small comletions perf uplift. main asks: customer SLAs, canary plan, and minimal launch criteria. put short blockers/recs in thread by EOD.

jamal_eng: +1. can we get clear p95 targets? some customers expect <100ms for embeddings which is rough on single-GPU for longer inputs.

sophia_ds: for embeddings: suggest we define two targets: interactive (<120ms p95, up to 512 tokens) and batch (throughput X). also need eval set for semantic recall regressions. i can assemble a 10-customer prompt suite.

kevin_product: agree. launch criteria proposal: 1) perf target (interactive p95) met on dedicated pool, 2) end-to-end cost within X% of baseline, 3) no high-sev regressions on eval suite, 4) canary w/ 10% traffic for 48h. thoughts?

olivia_support: FYI we've had 3 enterprise tickets last month complaining about embedding latency spikes during peak. customers: AtlasHealth and FinForge. both asked for region pinning.

jamal_eng: tradeoffs: getting to ~120ms p95 means enabling 8-bit quant + KV cache warmup + prefix caching. downside: small quality dip for some models; need quant QC.

ryan_research: i ran a quick microbench on rtx-a10 + llama-2-embed: baseline 210ms p95 for 512 tokens. with int8 it drops to 130–140ms, with small kernel tuning to ~118ms. attaching numbers next.

kevin_product: good. can we define acceptable quality delta threshold? e.g., cosine recall drop <= 1.5% on PR curve?

sophia_ds: 1.5% seems reasonable as a starting point. i'll run recall + clustering stability on the 10-customer suite. if we see >1.5% drop, we block.

jamal_eng: deployment notes: we'll need a canary image that supports both quantized and fp16 routes and an automatic fallback. sample deploy plan:
```
- deploy canary to eu-west-1 dedicated pool (10% traffic)
- monitor p95/mean, error rate, and recall regressions for 48h
- rollback if errors > 0.5% or recall drop > 1.5%
```

maria_pm: sounds good. decision items for PMs: set the exact cost delta budget (suggest <= 12% ops cost increase for latency improvements), confirm canary window (48h ok), and finalize eval suite owners.

olivia_support: also request a communication template for customers if we do a controlled rollback. customers ask for transparency.

kevin_product: i'll draft a short customer note and a post-canary playbook.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy window proposal posted: 2025-09-04 02:00-04:00 UTC.

ryan_research: next steps from research: share microbench CSV + initial quality diffs by tomorrow noon.

maria_pm: thanks all — i'll collate: 1) perf targets (interactive p95 120ms), 2) quality guardrail (<=1.5% recall drop), 3) cost budget (<=12% ops), 4) canary 10% 48h, 5) eval suite owner sophia. will post an updated PRD and invite infra/ops for rollout planning. :thumbsup:

jamal_eng: if infra can reserve extra warm GPU capacity during canary that reduces noise. tagging @eng-infra in the PRD.

kevin_product: /cc @sales for heads-up on enterprise customers.

olivia_support: adding sample customer note: "We're testing a performance upgrade in a controlled canary window. We'll notify you of impact and rollback decisions."

maria_pm: end — thanks, putting action items into the Q3 roadmap board.
